status: proposed construction - calculated, not built or measured (cost-first port, D-044)

basis.ratings_from: gen/port.py CMC160 / CMC200 desc (160 / 200 A DC, L_cm >= 0.5 mH @ 10 kHz, dT <= 40 K)

construction: one flat-mu nanocrystalline ring 63/38/25 mm (Shincore SC-1K107-LP class, mu 30 000) around both bars of the port, single pass, in a clip-on case; the 16 dB CM attenuation of ARCHITECTURE-COSTFIRST 8.1 comes from raising the module's CM capacitance to PE to >= 127 nF (port engineer, with the PE measures below), not from the ring

electrical.requirement: architecture 8.1: emission estimate 106-112 dBuV at 150-300 kHz with Y caps 2 x 9.4 nF and a 150 ohm CM network; CISPR 11 class A DC-port AV limit (from memory, verify) -> >= 16 dB CM attenuation at 150-500 kHz, >= 6 dB above

derivation_check.method: I_AN / I_source = Z_Y / (Z_Y + Z_choke + Z_AN): the switch-node CM source is capacitive (~kohm), so the choke only acts between the Y-cap node and the port; Z_Y of 18.8 nF, Z_AN 150 ohm, nanocrystalline |Z| at 45 deg

electrical.C_Y_consequence: 11.2 mA rms at 150 Hz into PE in the 800 V AC case: inside the 30 mA module limit (architecture 8.1) but above 3.5 mA touch current -> PE >= 10 mm2 Cu or a second PE terminal + warning label (IEC 62477-1 high-touch-current rule) - an architecture / safety decision

core.maker: Shincore (or Yunlu / AT&M flat grade) - RFQ
core.datasheet: MAS material SC-1K107-LP (OpenMagnetics); Yunlu catalogue (docs/datasheets/magnetics/Yunlu-Nanocrystalline-Cores.pdf p.6) for the adjustable-mu grades
core.rejected: high-mu 80 000 ring (architecture 8.1 default): saturates with the 150 Hz CM current (B ~3 T in case B)

windings.name: CMC160
windings.conductor: port bars pass through (10 x 5 mm tin-plated Cu (50 mm2))

windings.name: CMC200
windings.conductor: port bars pass through (10 x 7 mm tin-plated Cu (70 mm2))

insulation.system: the ring sits on sleeved bars (>= 0.75 mm, >= 1.5 kV DC); case CTI >= 600; the ring is not an insulation part (bars' own insulation is the basic insulation, IC-09 levels unchanged)

levels.label: Basic HV-PE, DC pole (Y caps, fuse bases, terminals)

insulation.routine_tests: AC 2200 V rms 1 s (or 2640 V 1 s) pole-pole and poles-core/case; L_cm at 10 kHz
insulation.type_tests: AC 2200 V rms 60 s; impulse 6 kV 1.2/50 (no surge credit); L_cm at 16/100 kHz with 1.7 A rms 150 Hz CM bias and rated DC; thermal run at rated DC (IC-09)

winding.formula: P_cu = 2 I_dc^2 R_pole (DC; the HF CM current is < 0.1 A)

loss_grid.note: no winding; core loss from the 150 Hz CM flux, < 1 W

thermal.basis: no winding loss; core loss < 1 W

cost.basis: ESTIMATES, no quote: flat nanocrystalline 20 USD/kg (0.27 kg) + case 1.5 + insulation 2 + labour 1, +10 %; the extra Y capacitance (~127 nF total) is the port engineer's BOM (~2 USD per port)
cost.cost_estimates_row: CM ring 63/38/25 (CUSTOM),11,"ESTIMATE (sim/magnetics.py design_port_cm_choke.json rev M2): flat-mu nanocrystalline ring 0.27 kg at 20 USD/kg + case/insulation/labour 4.5, +10 %; one per port, both ratings; no quote",low

openmagnetics.note: MAS |mu(f)| of SC-1K107-LP / Nanoperm 8000 used for all impedances (get_material_permeability)

previous_designer.architecture_8_1: one high-mu ring per port, single turn, |Z| >= 100 ohm, 12 USD for two cores

reference_M1.construction: 4 stacked flat-mu nanocrystalline toroids 80/50/25 mm (mu 11 000 +/-25 %), bifilar 3-turn formed copper bars (+ and - side by side), sleeved, potted with thermally conductive epoxy in a case bolted to the chassis; same core stack for CMC160 and CMC200, bar size differs
